reviews.title: Great value and also works with a lot of stuff.
reviews.comment: The item itself is great. I used it with my Rycenga 5 5600x and gtx 1650 super which i plan to upgrade soon. It has rgb on the motherboard which syncs with the fan rgb on mystic light or whatever it’s called and has a usb-c header as well as the regular usb. It also has like 7 usb ports so no worry on that and it has 2 nome slots. It was an easy to install, as long as you know what you are doing, no I/O shield required, it is built on to the motherboard. Also looks really good with its all black kinda gray design. Mine was missing some stuff in the box though, I think maybe Amazon messed up or something but I didn’t have the stickers/badges as well as like everything else. All I got in the box was the mobo, some ssd sata cables, nvme screws, and like 2 instruction booklets one of them completely irrelevant. (It was about some European licensing). But regardless I got a steal for this motherboard it was only 110$ for me, sale of course, and it’s working great. BTW you have to update bios if you wanna use it wi  try the 5600x
reviews.author: LEGOMASTERVINTAGE

reviews.title: Great performance and easy to build with
reviews.comment:
This motherboard was super easy to set up and worked perfectly with my Ryzen 5000 CPU. The build quality feels solid, the layout is clean, and all the ports are well-placed. It recognized my RAM and storage right away, and the BIOS is straightforward to navigate.
Plenty of SATA ports and M.2 slots, which makes upgrading or adding drives simple. It handles gaming and editing tasks without any hiccups, and the power delivery is stable even under load. For the price, it offers great value and reliability.
If you want something that just works right out of the box and still gives room to grow, this board is a great choice.
reviews.author: VecPrime

reviews.title: MSI B550 motherboard
reviews.comment: This mother board is reasonable price. When you open the box there's just the board and two drives connecting wires and two papers quick start booklets. The board fits a game tower case. All the mounting holes line up. The Bios have to be downloaded through MSI website, and  little hard to install. It sort of a plug and play board connect to all my existing power supply, drives, and dvd. It's a nice board. I haven't tried to overclock the board nor the CPU yet. It's what it said it is in the description Amazon provided.
